description.value: Trees Restaurant & Bakery is a full-service scratch kitchen and bakery on Vancouver Island's Alberni Highway in Parksville, serving breakfast, brunch, lunch, and dinner with a strong emphasis on fresh, locally sourced ingredients including island-raised free-range eggs and house-made breads. The menu is notable for its broad gluten-free offerings — including house-baked GF bread — and clearly labeled vegetarian options across multiple meal periods. A customer review notes a dog-friendly covered patio, which may appeal to cyclists travelling with pets.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Trees Restaurant & Bakery operates at 1385 Alberni Hwy, Parksville, BC V9P 2B8 — matching the OSM address — and lists the same phone number (250) 586-2226. The menu pages explicitly mark multiple items as gluten-free and vegetarian, and a customer review mentions 'dog friendly covered patio.' No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill services are mentioned anywhere on the site. A notable concern is the OSM name 'Trees' differs from the operating name 'Trees Restaurant & Bakery,' and the website reveals a second location at 3680 Alberni Hwy, Qualicum Beach, which is distinct from this OSM node.
